description: ERR-PARTIAL (F: lock granularity on a table spanning many pages), variant: without dbFailOnError. A second Workspace W2 opens the file; a dynaset on Big (2048 rows, about 100 pages) with LockEdits True runs FindFirst ID = k and Edit for k = 1, 1000 and 2048; for each k the first Database runs UPDATE Big SET V = 'u' with no options; Errors, RecordsAffected, COUNT of rows with V = 'u' and their MIN and MAX ID are read; W2 cancels and closes; the rows are reset (UPDATE ... WHERE V = 'u'). Decides whether rows on pages other than the locked row's page are updated or refused.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
